import itertools
import string
import pandas as pd

def task_func():
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

    alphabet = string.ascii_lowercase
    combinations = list(itertools.product(alphabet, repeat=3))

    df = pd.DataFrame(combinations, columns=["first", "second", "third"])

    first_letter_counts = (
        df["first"]
        .value_counts()
        .reindex(list(alphabet), fill_value=0)
    )

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    ax.bar(first_letter_counts.index, first_letter_counts.values)
    ax.set_xlabel("First letter")
    ax.set_ylabel("Frequency")
    ax.set_title("Frequency of First Letters in 3-Letter Combinations")

    return df, ax
